plan.subject: Marketing science

queries.query: ("left-digit effect" OR "charm pricing" OR "odd pricing" OR "price ending" OR ".99 pricing") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR commerce)
queries.rationale: Captures empirical studies on specific price-ending strategies to answer whether $9.99 still outperforms $10.00.

queries.query: ("price promotion" OR "deep discount" OR "promotional pricing" OR "price discount") AND ("brand equity" OR "brand image" OR "perceived quality" OR "brand value")
queries.rationale: Investigates the long-term trade-off between running sales and damaging the brand's perceived premium status.

queries.query: ("ad creative" OR "message framing" OR "emotional appeal" OR "rational appeal" OR "visual attention") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR advertising OR retail)
queries.rationale: Finds research on what elements of an advertisement actually capture attention and drive consumer action.

queries.query: ("brand naming" OR "product name" OR "phonetic symbolism" OR "alphanumeric brand" OR "sound symbolism") AND (marketing OR consumer OR retail OR ecommerce OR advertising)
queries.rationale: Targets linguistic and psychological studies on how the sound and structure of a product name influence consumer perception.

queries.query: ("scarcity message" OR "scarcity appeal" OR "limited time offer" OR "time pressure" OR "countdown timer" OR "limited quantity") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR "online shopping")
queries.rationale: Gathers evidence on FOMO tactics like countdown timers and low-stock warnings to see when they boost checkout rates versus cause reactance.

queries.query: ("choice architecture" OR "decoy effect" OR "compromise effect" OR "default option" OR "asymmetric dominance") AND (marketing OR consumer OR ecommerce OR retail OR "online shopping")
queries.rationale: Focuses on choice architecture and pricing tier structure to understand how presenting options changes the buyer's final selection.

queries.query: ("conversion rate" OR "landing page" OR "cart abandonment" OR "checkout process" OR "click-through rate") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR "online shopping" OR "online store" OR "digital marketing")
queries.rationale: Directly targets the core metrics of a growth marketer, pulling papers that analyze friction in the digital purchase journey.

queries.query: ("social proof" OR "review valence" OR "review volume" OR "electronic word of mouth" OR eWOM OR "online review") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR consumer OR marketing OR "purchase intention")
queries.rationale: Examines the quantitative impact of star ratings, review text, and social validation on ecommerce conversion.

queries.query: ("free shipping" OR "return policy" OR "shipping fee" OR "product return" OR "lenient return") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR "online shopping" OR "online retailer" OR consumer)
queries.rationale: Explores how shipping thresholds and return policies act as conversion levers and affect cart abandonment.

queries.query: ("user-generated content" OR UGC OR "influencer marketing" OR "micro-influencer" OR "sponsored post") AND (conversion OR "purchase intention" OR ROI OR "click-through" OR ecommerce)
queries.rationale: Looks past influencer hype to find studies measuring the actual return on investment and intent-to-buy generated by authentic content.

queries.query: ("cross-selling" OR "up-selling" OR "product recommendation" OR "bundle pricing" OR "price bundling") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR consumer OR marketing OR "online shopping")
queries.rationale: Focuses on tactics used to increase average order value, such as algorithmic recommendations and bundled discounts.

queries.query: ("customer lifetime value" OR CLV OR "loyalty program" OR "repurchase intention" OR "customer retention") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR DTC OR "direct to consumer" OR marketing)
queries.rationale: Addresses the post-purchase growth loop, finding evidence on what actually keeps customers coming back and spending more over time.

queries.query: ("subscription box" OR "subscription model" OR "replenishment" OR "subscribe and save") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR consumer OR marketing OR DTC)
queries.rationale: Captures the DTC-heavy subscription mechanics to see what drives sign-ups and prevents churn in recurring revenue models.

queries.query: ("personalized recommendation" OR "behavioral targeting" OR retargeting OR "personalized advertising" OR "dynamic pricing") AND (ecommerce OR retail OR consumer OR marketing OR "online shopping")
queries.rationale: Evaluates the effectiveness of data-driven targeting and retargeting ads on final conversion metrics.

plan.coverage_notes: The plan is heavily skewed toward Pattern A queries, anchoring specific behavioral economics and digital marketing phenomena to general ecommerce/retail contexts. Coverage spans the entire DTC growth funnel: ad creative, product naming, pricing psychology, landing page nudges, cart mechanics, and post-purchase retention. Theoretical advertising history, traditional media studies, and broad brand-building frameworks were deliberately excluded in favor of measurable, conversion-focused variables like 'purchase intention' and 'click-through rate' to match the reader's preference for hard numbers and practical application.
